name: Windows 98
description: The Active Desktop era with web integration, gradient title bars, Quick Launch toolbar, enhanced multimedia, and improved USB support. Windows 98 built on 95's foundation with tighter Internet Explorer 4 integration and a more polished shell.
author: Desktop Time Machine

meta.historicalNote: Windows 98 sold 580,000 copies in its first four days and introduced the Quick Launch toolbar, Active Desktop, and the Windows Update feature. It was the last DOS-based Windows before the NT kernel unified the line.
